title: Fix absolute local path link in README Local development
lead: The README's link to the CLI README is relative, so it resolves on GitHub, in NuGet-adjacent views, and in any clone.
findings_note: README.md:177 links to /Users/jon/code/squalor-xyz/obfuscator/Obfuscator.Cli/README.md; broken on GitHub and for every other clone
boundary: **Not in this slice:** other README wording or structure; links in other documents (none are absolute).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: `README.md` Local development links to `/Users/jon/code/squalor-xyz/obfuscator/Obfuscator.Cli/README.md`, an absolute path on one machine (with the wrong case for the repo directory), so the link is broken everywhere else.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: `rg -n '\]\(/' -g '*.md'` outside `.slicer/` and `.worktrees/` finds no absolute links; `Obfuscator.Cli/README.md` exists at that relative path; `slicer check` passes.
